newsitem.title: USA: LPC-DLJ lends Katz Media $210 mln for recap.
newsitem.headline: LPC-DLJ lends Katz Media $210 mln for recap.

text.p: NEW YORK, Nov 20 (LPC) - Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette is leading syndication of a $210 million bank loan to be used in a recapitalization of Katz Media Group Inc, banking sources said.
The credit facility, which complements a $100 million issuance of 10-year notes registered under rule 144A, will be used in part to repay debt, bankers added.
The deal is split between a $110 million revolving portion and a $60 million amortizing term loan, both of which are 6.75 years in maturity, a banker said.
There also is a $40 million, eight-year, B term loan to be sold to institutional investors, such as prime rate funds and insurance companies, the banker added.
Pricing on the loan is tied to the company's leverage, lenders said.
